title: Expected moved keys when growing from four nodes to five
method: Analytical synthetic population 100,000 uniformly hashed keys. Modulo 4→5 changes approximately 80%=80,000 owners. Ideal balanced minimal-disruption addition moves 1/5=20%=20,000. Real ring balance, weights, key sizes and traffic skew can differ.
alt: Expected moved keys when growing from four nodes to five. Modulo assignment: 80000 keys; Balanced minimal movement: 20000 keys. Illustrative values.
